claim: In the HWA laboratory, RECOVTEST demonstrated recovery behavior: FAIL_STOP ended ABEND with return code 7; FAIL_CONT ended ABEND but used RECOVERY CONTINUE; FAIL_RERUN first ended ABEND and then reran after one minute, completing SUCC with return code 0 on the first retry.
supporting_quote: FAIL_STOP ABEND ... 7; FAIL_CONT ABEND ... 7; FAIL_RERUN ABEND ... 7; rerun 1 of 2 FAIL_RERUN SUCC ... 0.
notes: The stream overall was ABEND because it contained the STOP failure. The rerun script was stateful and succeeded on its retry.
